name: Kirimase
summary: CLI that installs and configures a Next.js stack (ORM, auth, shadcn/ui, Stripe, Resend, tRPC) and scaffolds CRUD code.
description: A command-line tool for building full-stack Next.js apps faster, with three commands: init, add and generate. add installs and configures a modular pick of packages — Prisma or Drizzle, Auth.js, Clerk, Lucia or Kinde, shadcn/ui, Stripe, Resend and tRPC; generate scaffolds DB schema, migrations, service files, API and tRPC routes and basic CRUD UI from a data model.
contains: add configures ORM, auth, component library, payments, email and tRPC
package choices: Prisma, Drizzle, Auth.js, Clerk, Lucia, Kinde, shadcn/ui, Stripe, Resend
generate scaffolds schema, migrations, services, routes and CRUD UI
modular package choices instead of one fixed template repo
